summary: Frontend-only regression test of the 'BEST SCORE = longest distance in meters' bug fix. All targeted behaviors verified successfully via Playwright at 390x844: Main Menu BEST SCORE renders formatInt(bestDistance)+'m' from dp_bestDistance; legacy dp_bestScore key is fully orphaned (injected value 99 is ignored on load); Game Over overlay has NO go-score/go-best rows (only go-distance, go-best-distance, go-chips); NEW BEST badge appears only when distance strictly exceeds previous best; shorter run never decreases best; persistence across reload confirmed.

verification_matrix.shorter_run_no_decrease: PASS (15m run with prior best 250m -> menu still 250m, no NEW BEST badge)
verification_matrix.new_best_badge_on_improvement: PASS (reset to 0, fresh run 19m -> new-best-badge count=1)
verification_matrix.legacy_key_not_written: PASS (dp_bestScore remains stale value 99, never overwritten by fix code)

critical_code_review_comments: handleCrash / MainMenu / GameOverOverlay / persistence.js all consistently reference bestDistance only; obstacle-count best is completely removed as claimed.
GameScreen passes bestDistance={Math.max(bestDistance, over.distance)} to GameOverOverlay so BEST DISTANCE row reflects the just-set new best inline, which is correct.

Easy Mode routing in App.js correctly forwards state.bestDistanceSilly to GameScreen when modeForSelection(selectedMap)==='easy', preserving separation from Normal Mode bestDistance (regression-safe).
Non-blocking: several React Native Web deprecation warnings (props.pointerEvents, shadow*, textShadow*) - cosmetic, not caused by this fix.
seed_data_creation: Injected localStorage values for dp_bestDistance and legacy dp_bestScore via page.evaluate to force deterministic states.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified end-to-end at 390x844 preview URL. Easy Mode's bestDistanceSilly was not exercised (would need DEV Simulate Success purchase), but code review confirms it is on a separate branch untouched by this fix. Chip/fatness independence not directly forced but confirmed via code inspection (handleCrash only updates bestDistance based on distance param).
rca of the issue: N/A - this run is a verification of an existing fix, no bug reproduced.
